Goood · Onboarding prototype

Mood check-in

Starts on the iPhone home screen. Tap the Goood icon and the app opens out of it into the splash. The splash plays for 3 seconds. Then the sun rises into daylight, the moon sets, and the centre ring drops and becomes the seedling on the Onboarding screen from Figma. Drag the ruler or the mood pills, tap a mood, or use the arrow keys. The seedling's face and leaves respond to each mood. Tap the tick and the selected seedling flies down into the Homepage's mood carousel, with that mood already selected. On the Homepage "Growing" types itself in, the tree grows leaf by leaf in front of the 5 (tap the tree to replay), the bell rings, and you can tap it, play the Library session (with a calm, generated soundscape), swipe the Library cards and the Sounds cards either way, tap Listen on "I am Calm" or on the Rain, Ocean and Forest cards to hear each one's own soundscape in the mini player, scroll down to watch "You Are goood" write itself at the bottom, and tap "View all" on the Library section to open the Library page (tabs, swipeable cards and three more players).

    Built from Figma frame Onboarding · 127:5447 using its own photo, gradient, seedling SVG, icons and ruler mask. The seedling's expressions only switch on layers that already exist in the component (eyes, lids, brows, "o" mouth, glow, leaves). Makira isn't available on the web font service here, so Bricolage Grotesque stands in until the Makira files are added.
